newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ZABEL WINS EIGHTH STAGE IN A PHOTO-FINISH.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZABEL WINS EIGHTH STAGE IN A PHOTO-FINISH.

text.p: Erik Zabel scored his third stage victory in the Tour de France on Sunday when he won a photo-finish verdict to take the eighth stage.

The German edged out Italian Nicola Minali and Dutchman Jeroen Blijlevens, with Frenchman Frederic Moncassin fourth after the quartet hit the finish line together at the end of the 161.5-km race from Bordeaux to Pau.
With time deductions for his victory and a victory in an intermediate sprint, Zabel cut the overall lead of Cedric Vasseur of France to one minute and 21 seconds.
Zabel won Saturday's stage and crossed the line first on Friday but was later disqualified and pushed back to last for pushing. REUTER
